evidence.quote: cuyos productos sean accesibles para niños, niñas y adolescentes en el territorio nacional

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Decree adding Title 31 to Decree 1078 of 2015 to regulate Law 2489 of 2025 on safe digital environments for children and adolescents. Imposes risk-mitigation, age-verification, parental-control, privacy-by-design and reporting duties on digital service providers and the software industry, and creates coordination bodies. Effective 18 July 2026.
summary.long: Decree 769 of 16 July 2026 adds Title 31 to Decree 1078 of 2015 to regulate Law 2489 of 2025 on safe digital environments for children and adolescents. Private duties fall on telecommunications network providers, digital platforms and service providers, and the software industry, including AI system developers (Arts. 2.2.31.1.2, 2.2.31.3.4). Measures against harmful content include mandatory blocking and immediate reporting of child sexual exploitation material, parental control tools and risk-based age verification (Art. 2.2.31.2.6). Providers must implement privacy and security by design and by default (Art. 2.2.31.2.8). Algorithm guidelines cover child-rights impact assessment, bias mitigation and data protection, framed as self-regulation (Art. 2.2.31.3.2). The state monitoring system is barred from collecting biometric data or commercially profiling children (Art. 2.2.31.6.2). Covered providers file semi-annual reports with MinTIC (Art. 2.2.31.3.5), and MinTIC issues technical definitions and policy within twelve months (Arts. 2.2.31.1.3, 2.2.31.2.1). The decree regulates coordination bodies, a monitoring system, a good-practice repository and school guidelines (Chapters 2-6). The decree sets no penalties; MinTIC supervision follows the sanctions regime of Law 1341 of 2009 (Art. 2.2.31.3.3).

notes: Many operative provisions defer detail to later MinTIC resolutions or joint resolutions (Arts. 2.2.31.1.3, 2.2.31.2.8, 2.2.31.4.3, 2.2.31.5.1). Internal tension: Art. 2.2.31.1.2 Par. 1 and Art. 2.2.31.2.6 a) state obligations and 'Estas medidas son de obligatorio cumplimiento', while Art. 2.2.31.3.2 Par. 2 describes the guidelines as 'una práctica de autorregulación' and Art. 2.2.31.3.6 refers to voluntary instruments. The 'Rige a partir del 18 de julio de 2026' header comes from compilation metadata; Art. 2 sets entry into force the day after publication in the Diario Oficial (17 July 2026). Ley 1978 de 2019 appears only as modifying Ley 1341 de 2009 in the text; this decree does not amend it. Minor typographic errors in the text (stray quotation marks in Arts. 2.2.31.3.3 and 2.2.31.6.7) are reproduced, not corrected.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff changes legal treatment in the operative provisions. Scope is set by functional criteria (role, nature of service, risk level, interaction with children) in Arts. 2.2.31.1.2 and 2.2.31.2.4, with no size or volume test. The numbers present are procedural time limits, coded as events rather than thresholds: 12-month periods in Arts. 2.2.31.1.3 and 2.2.31.2.1, the 6 February annual report deadline in Art. 2.2.31.6.5, and the semi-annual reporting period in Art. 2.2.31.3.5. The 500 consultation submissions in the considerandos are context, not a legal cutoff. Age-related provisions (Art. 2.2.31.2.6(c), Art. 2.2.31.2.7) contain no numeric age value.
